+        # ====================================================
+        # JAW_CORRIDOR_CLOSE_LATCH_V1
+        #
+        # CLOSE_SETTLE is now a latched mechanical settling phase.
+        #
+        # Entry condition has ALREADY been verified:
+        #   External close condition
+        #   +
+        #   Right Wrist jaw corridor latched
+        #
+        # After entry:
+        #   - freeze Cartesian motion,
+        #   - do NOT re-check noisy Wrist visual measurements,
+        #   - wait close_hold_s,
+        #   - issue CLOSE once.
+        # ====================================================
+
+        if self.state == "CLOSE_SETTLE":
+
+            self._publish_close_settle(
+                True,
+                "LATCHED_HOLD",
+            )
+
+            if self.close_ready_since is None:
+
+                self.close_ready_since = now
+
+
+            if (
+                now
+                -
+                self.close_ready_since
+                >=
+                self.close_hold_s
+            ):
+
+                if (
+                    self.enabled
+                    and
+                    self.open_issued
+                    and
+                    not self.close_issued
+                ):
+
+                    output.set_gripper_goal(
+                        1,
+                        float(
+                            GRIPPER_CLOSE_Q[1]
+                        ),
+                    )
+
+                    self.close_issued = True
+
+                    self.state = (
+                        "WAIT_CONTACT"
+                    )
+
+                    self.action_started_at = now
+
+                    self.close_ready_since = None
+
+                    self._publish_close_settle(
+                        True,
+                        "CLOSE_ISSUED",
+                    )
+
+                    print(
+                        "[AUTO GRASP DIRECT] "
+                        "CLOSE_ONCE "
+                        "source=JAW_CORRIDOR_LATCH "
+                        f"target={float(GRIPPER_CLOSE_Q[1]):+.5f}",
+                        flush=True,
+                    )
+
+
+            self._log(
+                now
+            )
+
+            return
+
+
